features.title: Source text and lexical forms
pending: Invalid UTF-8 source and diagnostic positions; CRLF and source normalization
Identifier categories, reserved words and malformed literals

features.title: Strings and UTF-8
pending: Remaining String receiver APIs
Embedded-expression boundaries beyond the reviewed interpolation probes
features.note: Ordinary UTF-8 literals, code-point size/index, collections and NUL/long data are covered. Additional CLI tests cover argv, invalid source, forced GC and terminal editing. String empty/include/start/end queries and nullable first/last search now share code-point offsets, argument ordering, optional receivers and managed lifetime checks. The remaining String APIs stay open. Chars, codepoints and reverse preserve code-point units, independent result storage, NUL, optional receivers and managed lifetimes. String slice now accepts checked code-point ranges, retaining receiver identity and optional short circuit; negative, reversed and out-of-bounds ranges fail explicitly. Control, octal, hex and scalar Unicode escapes preserve exact bytes, reject invalid scalar/digit forms and do not recursively start interpolation. Strip, lstrip and rstrip use the reference Unicode White_Space set, preserve retained bytes and manage optional, generic, captured and stored values.

features.title: Numeric and Boolean operations
pending: All operators and assignment forms; mixed widening and every portable failure boundary
Short-circuit side effects and invalid RHS diagnostics across nested control
features.note: Integer receiver operations and Float abs/floor/ceil/round/finite?/infinite?/nan?/to_i use typed MIR and checked portable conversions. Shared probes cover ties, limits, subnormals, signed zero, NaN, infinities, optional calls and managed captures; broader numeric APIs and Float String conversion remain open.

features.title: Bindings, constants and mutation
pending: Shadowing, duplicate declarations, unused/discard bindings and mutation through projections

features.title: Function declarations and calls
pending: Every all-path return, evaluation-order and mutable-argument boundary

features.title: Defaults and named arguments
pending: Method, function-value and payload-enum argument parity
features.note: Positional and named-only defaults have declaration-scoped, typed MIR initializer bodies. Explicit expressions precede omitted defaults; checking and the REPL share binding identities.

features.title: Conditions and value-producing branches
pending: Nullable/union common result types and broader expression nesting boundaries
features.note: Value branches have typed MIR joins, numeric widening and lexical transfer propagation; shared probes cover effects, scope and managed aliases.

features.title: Loop control and transfers
pending: Additional nested transfer and diagnostic-origin differential probes
features.note: Conditional return, break and next evaluate the guard first and share lexical targets with MIR and the REPL.

features.title: Case statements and expressions
pending: Exhaustiveness, repeated/unreachable branches and pattern-binding diagnostics
features.note: Integer and String selectors with literal alternatives are supported; value-producing cases currently require else.

features.title: Records and field bindings
pending: Nominal cycles and defaults involving remaining unsupported value types
features.note: Generic and ordinary defaults share declaration-scoped initializers; explicit fields run before omitted defaults, with fresh managed values and independent concrete type instances.

features.title: Member access and projections
pending: Safe member access, chained field narrowing and receiver replacement

features.title: Nullable values and narrowing
pending: Class/callback and general pattern narrowing; collection/union optional conversions
Nullable standard-library methods beyond the currently implemented Native APIs
features.note: Native uses explicit typed none/present/test/extraction MIR with traced payload storage and checked extraction. Direct lexical/stable record-field guards, returning guards, short-circuit RHS and safe navigation are covered; chained predicates do not export extra narrowing facts. Retained REPL assignments use checked exit facts; partial failure and interruption clear earlier narrowing. Conditional/failure probes expose known bugs in the fixed reference revision, and statement-control result display remains different.

features.title: Enums and tagged values
pending: Raw values and conversion failures, enum methods and attributes
Nested module declarations and wider pattern forms
features.note: Ordinary nominal payloads, required positional/named arguments, exhaustive cases, scoped immutable bindings, recursive managed fields and aliases are covered. CLI tests additionally cover retained identities and replay.

features.title: Transparent aliases
pending: Literal/union and class/interface alias targets; nested module declarations
Authored alias spelling in REPL display and diagnostics
features.note: Transparent and generic aliases resolve to canonical checked types before MIR. Probes cover declaration scope, recursive nominal targets, defaults, Result, enum patterns and invalid unused aliases. Pinned reference defects remain explicit.

features.title: Nominal newtypes
pending: Closed/private constructors, methods, immutable representation and boundary diagnostics

features.title: Generic declarations and applications
pending: Generic methods, classes and interfaces
Wider constraints and type applications
features.note: Explicit record/enum and top-level function applications use concrete checked MIR. Function templates and record/parameter defaults are checked even when unused. Imported generic enum identity, local shadowing and full control defaults agree with the updated reference; remaining Hash REPL display differences stay explicit.

features.title: Literal types and discriminated unions
pending: Shared discriminants, branch narrowing and invalid mutation/common-type boundaries

features.title: Function values and lexical capture
pending: Callable equality, method references and remaining parameter-capability/narrowing combinations
features.note: Ordinary files and retained REPL submissions construct anonymous and named function values using concrete checked bodies and their originating code/type catalogs. Required positional named declarations preserve import identity, lexical shadowing, managed storage, nullable narrowing, Result obligations and generic type applications. Defaults, named-only and generic declarations require explicit fn adapters. CLI controls additionally cover cross-submission calls, failures, collection and replay. Other boundaries and diagnostic differences remain explicit.

features.title: Arrays and checked indexes
pending: Remaining Array sorting and safe APIs
Wider invalid element/mutation combinations
features.note: Array edges/copies/slicing, mutable insertion/removal, scalar/payloadless equality queries, uniqueness, shallow concatenation and String joining share typed MIR and REPL behavior. Cases cover retained receivers, argument effects, nullable calls, managed aliases, Unicode/NUL, NaN and signed zero. Remaining methods and diagnostic differences stay explicit.

features.title: Hash values and operations
pending: All key/value representations, empty inference, managed lifetimes and missing-key failures
features.note: Colon keys support quoted and computed String keys, Integer keys and parenthesized identifier labels, retaining authored key/value evaluation order. Boolean and nil keys remain rejected.

features.title: Structured and value-producing iteration
pending: Keyed sorting and sliced iteration
Remaining receiver APIs that shorten or reorder an Array during traversal
features.note: Array and Range each/map/select/reduce use shared checked statement bodies and ordinary MIR loops. Transforms retain one receiver, observe live Array growth/replacement, preserve visited selection values and evaluate reduce initializers before traversal. Indexed map/select and managed captures are covered. Short-circuit any?/all?/none? retain the same live source, require Boolean results and lower early exits to ordinary MIR edges. find/find_index retain visited values and produce checked nullable results with short-circuit exits. Hash each snapshots keys and values before its body; insertion, deletion, rebinding, managed aliases and loop transfers are covered without promising enumeration order.

features.title: Range values and boundaries
features.note: Materialization shares each endpoint rules, creates a fresh Array and exits before incrementing an inclusive portable maximum.

features.title: Result and typed propagation
pending: General union errors and compiler-declared structured package boundaries
features.note: Compiler-owned Result/Unit, ordinary case/try/catch, required-use and managed payloads use existing verified enum/control MIR. REPL controls cover automatic roots, aliases, retained values and reload. Optional error widening exposes a fixed-reference build/REPL defect; current reference main handles it correctly.

features.title: Classes, fields and methods
pending: Initialization, inheritance, dispatch, privacy and readonly fields

features.title: Explicit interface conformance
pending: Generic conformance, variance, inherited contracts and rejection controls

features.title: Modules and constant lookup
pending: Cross-module constants, member visibility and runtime initialization order
features.note: The pinned reference compiles the module-constant fixture but its REPL cannot resolve the module value.

features.title: Symbol values
pending: Symbol typing, equality and public receiver operations

features.title: Project imports and declaration identity
pending: Bare/named aliases, graph conflicts, missing/unused imports and file/project/REPL identity
features.note: Named aliases, automatic project imports, record binding identity and standard-package aliases have ordinary probes; broader import and diagnostic contracts remain.

features.title: Target source interop
pending: Go/Ruby/TypeScript source emission and platform interop
features.note: A later toolchain contract is required; these remain project goals, not basic Native support claims.

features.title: JSX and web bindings
pending: Typed JSX and official web-package boundaries
features.note: Requires the source backend and web package contracts; remains in the complete toolchain goal.

features.title: Package capability activation
pending: Package-owned activation and resolution
features.note: Requires package resolution and its capability contract; remains in the complete toolchain goal.

features.title: Retired authored attempt syntax
features.note: The reference AST retains this node for pre-0.3 recovery; authored attempt syntax is rejected, not a language capability to implement.

def trace(label: String, value: String): String

	return value + "!"
end

def collect(mut values: Array<String> = [], *, label: String = trace("default-label", "item")): String
	values.push(label)
	return values.size().to_s() + ":" + values[0]
end

def select(first: Integer, second: Integer = first + 1, *, third: Integer = second + 1): Integer
	return first * 100 + second * 10 + third
end

def fresh_hash(mut values: Hash<String, Array<String>> = { "key" =>["kept"] }): Integer
	mut items := values["key"]
	items.push("grown")
	return items.size()
end

record Entry
	first: String
	second: String = trace("default-second", first)
	items: Array<String> = [second]
	count: Float = items.size()
end

def identity(*, entry: Entry = Entry.new(first: trace("default-first", "record"))): Entry
	return entry
end

def lazy(value: Boolean = false && (1 / 0 == 0)): Boolean
	return value
end

def probe()
	puts(collect())
	puts(collect())
	mut values := ["explicit"]
	puts(collect(values, label: trace("explicit-label", "later")))
	puts(values.size())
	puts(select(1))
	puts(select(1, third: 8))
	puts(select(1, 4))
	puts(fresh_hash())
	puts(fresh_hash())
	first := Entry.new(second: trace("explicit-second", "second"), first: trace("explicit-first", "first"))
	puts(first.first)
	puts(first.second)
	puts(first.items[0])
	puts(first.count.to_i())
	second := identity()
	third := identity()
	mut items := second.items
	items.push("added")
	puts(items.size())
	puts(third.items.size())
	puts(third.items[0])
	puts(lazy())
	puts(lazy(true))
end

cases.title: Brace iteration with nested controls and lexical transfers
cases.declarations:
def probe(): Integer
	mut values := ["a", "b" + "b"]
	mut total := 0
	values.each.with_index { |value, index|
		if index == 0
			values.push("c" + "cc")
			next
		end
		(1..3).each { |step|
			if step == 2
				next
			end
			mut turn := 0
			while turn < 3
				turn += 1
				break if turn == 2
				total += value.size() + index + step
			end
			break if step == 3
		}
		if index == 2
			return total
		end
	}
	return - 1
end

def brace_controls()
	puts(probe())
	[1, 2].each { |value| if value == 1; puts("first"); else; puts("second"); end }
	(2...4).each() { |value|
		case value
		when 2
			puts("two")
		else
			puts("three")
		end
	}
end

def source(mut events: Array<Integer>, values: Array<Integer>): Array<Integer>
	events.push(1)
	return values
end

def initial(mut events: Array<Integer>, mut values: Array<Integer>): Integer
	events.push(2)
	values.push(3)
	return 10
end

def probe()
	mut values := [1, 2]
	mut retained := values
	mut calls: Array<Integer> := []
	mapped := source(calls, values).map.with_index do |item, index|
		if index == 0
			retained.push(3)
			retained[1] = 20
			values = [99]
		end
		index = 100
		item + index
	end
	puts(calls.size())
	puts(mapped.size())
	puts(mapped[1])
	puts(mapped[2])
	puts(values[0])
	mut original := [4, 5]
	selected := original.select.with_index do |item, index|
		original[index] = 40
		item = 90
		item > index
	end
	puts(selected[0])
	puts(selected[1])
	mut numbers := [1, 2]
	mut events: Array<Integer> := []
	total := source(events, numbers).reduce(initial(events, numbers)) do |sum, item|
		events.push(item + 2)
		sum + item
	end
	puts(total)
	puts(events[0])
	puts(events[1])
	puts(events.size())
	mut nested := [[1], [2]]
	readonly := nested
	result := readonly.map do |row|
		row.push(3)
		row.size()
	end
	puts(result[0])

end

cases.title: Short-circuit Array and Range predicates and boundary values
cases.declarations:
def probe()
	empty: Array<Integer> := []
	missing := empty.any? { |item| item > 0 }
	complete := empty.all? { |item| item > 0 }
	absent := empty.none? { |item| item > 0 }
	puts(missing)
	puts(complete)
	puts(absent)
	mut visits := 0
	found := [1, 2, 3].any? do |item|
		visits += 1
		item == 2
	end
	puts(found)
	puts(visits)
	visits = 0
	every := [1, 2, 3].all?() do |item|
		visits += 1
		item < 2
	end
	puts(every)
	puts(visits)
	visits = 0
	no_match := [1, 2, 3].none? do |item|
		visits += 1
		item == 2
	end
	puts(no_match)
	puts(visits)
	all_small := [1, 2].all? { |item| item < 3 }
	none_small := [1, 2].none? { |item| item > 3 }
	any_large := [1, 2].any? { |item| item > 3 }
	puts(all_small)
	puts(none_small)
	puts(any_large)
	maximum := (9007199254740991..9007199254740991).all? { |item| item > 0 }
	excluded := (9007199254740991...9007199254740991).any? { |item| item > 0 }
	reversed := (3..1).none? { |item| item > 0 }
	puts(maximum)
	puts(excluded)
	puts(reversed)
	# Stop after the second element.
	finite := (1..3).any? { |item| item == 2 }
	puts(finite)
	mut outer := 0
	nested := [1, 2].all? do |item|
		outer += 1
		answer := (1..3).any? { |other| item == other }
		answer
	end
	puts(nested)
	puts(outer)
	# Lazy evaluation must skip the zero divisor after the first match.
	lazy := [1, 0].any? { |item| 10 / item > 0 }
	puts(lazy)
end

def matches<T>(values: Array<T>, predicate: (T) -> Boolean): Boolean
	return values.any? { |item| predicate(item) }
end

def source(mut events: Array<Integer>, values: Array<Integer>): Array<Integer>
	events.push(1)
	return values
end

def probe()
	mut values := [1, 2]
	mut retained := values
	readonly := retained
	mut events: Array<Integer> := []
	found := source(events, readonly).any? do |item|
		events.push(item)
		if item == 1
			retained.push(3)
			retained[1] = 20
			values = [99]
		end
		item == 3
	end
	puts(found)
	puts(events.size())
	puts(events[2])
	puts(events[3])
	puts(values[0])
	mut captured: Array<() -> String> := []
	labels := ["first" + 1.to_s(), "target" + 2.to_s(), "unvisited"]
	selected := labels.any? do |label|
		callback := fn(): String
			return label
		end
		captured.push(callback)
		label = label + "!"
		label == "target2!"
	end
	puts(selected)
	puts(captured.size())
	puts(captured[0]())
	puts(captured[1]())
	predicate := fn(value: String): Boolean
		return value == "target2"
	end
	puts(matches<String>(labels, predicate))
	checker := fn(values: Array<Integer>): Boolean
		return values.none? { |item| item == 0 }
	end
	puts(checker([1, 2]))
end

record Entry
	name: String
end

def first<T>(values: Array<T>, predicate: (T) -> Boolean): T?
	return values.find { |item| predicate(item) }

def probe()
	mut source := [Entry.new(name: "original" + 1.to_s())]
	selected := source.find do |item|
		source[0] = Entry.new(name: "replacement")
		item = Entry.new(name: "parameter")
		item.name == "parameter"
	end
	if selected != nil
		puts(selected.name)
	end
	mut values := [1, 2]
	mut retained := values
	mut calls := 0
	index := values.find_index do |item|
		calls += 1
		if item == 1
			retained[1] = 20
			retained.push(3)
			values = [99]
		end
		item == 3
	end
	if index != nil
		puts(index)
	end
	puts(calls)
	puts(values[0])
	mut callbacks: Array<() -> String> := []
	text := ["first" + 1.to_s(), "second" + 2.to_s()].find do |item|
		callback := fn(): String
			return item
		end
		callbacks.push(callback)
		item = item + "!"
		item == "second2!"
	end
	if text != nil
		puts(text)
	end
	puts(callbacks[1]())
	predicate := fn(value: String): Boolean
		return value == "generic"
	end
	result := first<String>(["generic"], predicate)
	if result != nil
		puts(result)
	end
end

cases.title: Integer method order
cases.declarations:
def optional_absolute(value: Integer?): Integer?
	return value&.abs()
end

def record_value(mut events: Array<Integer>, tag: Integer, value: Integer): Integer
	events.push(tag)
	return value
end

def probe()
	mut events: Array<Integer> := []
	result := record_value(events, 1, - 5).clamp(record_value(events, 2, - 2), record_value(events, 3, 2))
	puts(result)
	events.each { |item| puts(item) }
	mut maybe: Integer? := nil
	absent := maybe&.clamp(record_value(events, 4, 0), record_value(events, 5, 1))
	puts(absent == nil)
	puts(events.size())
	maybe =- 7
	present := optional_absolute(maybe)
	if present != nil
		puts(present)
	end
	callback := fn(value: Integer): Integer
		return value.abs().clamp(2, 5)
	end
	mapped := [- 7, 1, 3].map { |value| callback(value) }
	mapped.each { |value| puts(value) }
	text := "held" + result.to_s()
	puts(text)
end

record Entry
 label: Text
end

 take := fn(): Text
  calls += 1
  return entry.label
 end
 chars := take().chars()
 points := take().codepoints()
 reversed := take().reverse()
 mut garbage := ""
 (0...10).each { |i| garbage += i.to_s() }
 puts(chars[1])
 puts(points[1])
 puts(reversed)
 puts(calls)
 puts(garbage.size())
end
